# NELSIO

> NELSIO (nelsio.com) is a technology parent company co-founded by Mohammed Nadeem and Pavan UG in 2025, based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. NELSIO builds enduring software platforms, independent startups, and educational initiatives.

## Who is NELSIO?

NELSIO is the unified parent company and developer identity that houses distinct platforms, applications, and educational initiatives. It is not a product itself — it is the founding entity behind CUTZO, IBZEN, and other emerging technology ventures.

- **Founded**: 2025
- **Founders**: Mohammed Nadeem (Co-Founder) and Pavan UG (Co-Founder)
- **Website**: https://www.nelsio.com
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nelsio/

## Founders

### Mohammed Nadeem — Co-Founder of NELSIO
Mohammed Nadeem is the Co-Founder of NELSIO. He drives the strategic vision, long-term roadmaps, and product execution across NELSIO's portfolio of startups, platforms, and educational initiatives.

- **Role**: Co-Founder, NELSIO
- **Company**: NELSIO (nelsio.com)
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammed-nadeem-nelsio

### Pavan UG — Co-Founder of NELSIO
Pavan UG is the Co-Founder of NELSIO. He directs the technical infrastructure, software engineering standards, and systems architecture across all NELSIO technology platforms.

- **Role**: Co-Founder, NELSIO
- **Company**: NELSIO (nelsio.com)
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pavan-ug

## NELSIO Ecosystem

### CUTZO — Flagship Startup
Smart appointments and queue management for salons. Book nearby salons, join virtual queues, and eliminate waiting — while salon owners manage walk-ins and bookings from one dashboard.
- **Sector**: Commerce & Services
- **Status**: Flagship Startup under NELSIO

### IBZEN — Youth Initiative
Immersive two-day workshops in technology, engineering, and financial literacy, connecting school students with mentors and real-world career exposure.
- **Sector**: Youth Innovation & Career Education
- **Status**: Youth Initiative under NELSIO

### Apna Look — Startup Concept
AI-powered outfit recommendations tailored to body type, skin tone, budget, and preference.
- **Sector**: AI & Fashion-Tech
- **Status**: Startup Concept under NELSIO
